## Ananicy 2.X configuration
# Ananicy run full system scan every "check_freq" seconds
# supported values 0.01..86400
# values which have sense: 1..60
check_freq = 15

# Disables functionality
cgroup_load = true
type_load = true
rule_load = true

apply_nice = true
apply_latnice = true
apply_ionice = true
apply_sched = true
apply_oom_score_adj = true
apply_cgroup = true

# Loglevel
# supported values: trace, debug, info, warn, error, critical
loglevel = info

# If enabled it does log task name after rule matched and got applied to the task
log_applied_rule = false

# It tries to move realtime task to root cgroup to be able to move it to the ananicy-cpp controlled one
# NOTE: may introduce issues, for example with polkit
cgroup_realtime_workaround = false

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

from boot import ROOT, slot
import backends
import lib
import netpeer
import run


def single(label, workload='udp', observe=False, profile=False, pin='16-23'):
    directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='vl5-'))
    retained = ROOT / '.scratch/perf5/runs' / (directory.name + '-' + label)
    retained.mkdir(parents=True)
    result = {'label': label, 'workload': workload, 'retained': str(retained),
              'temporary': str(directory), 'load_start': lib.read_loadavg(), 'pin': pin}
    peer = backend = agent = watcher = profiler = profile_output = None
    stop = threading.Event()
    try:
        guest = 'ubuntu-26.04'
        version = lib.latest_template('x86_64', guest)
        overlay, code, variables = lib.prepare_run_dir(str(directory), 'x86_64', guest, version)
        net = lib.BENCH_NET
        peer = netpeer.Peer(str(directory), net['guest_ip'], net['guest_mac'], net['port'], run.log)
        common = (str(directory), guest, 2, pin, overlay, code, variables,
                  peer.switch_sock, net['guest_mac'], net['mtu'], run.log)
        if label == 'qemu':
            backend = backends.X86QemuBackend(*common)
        else:
            binary = ROOT / '.scratch/perf5/binaries' / label / 'vmlab-hv'
            backend = backends.X86HvBackend(*common, str(binary), lib.IPXE_ROM)
        if observe:
            backend.vm_argv[:0] = ['env', f'LD_PRELOAD={ROOT}/.scratch/perf5/observe-v2.so',
                                  f'PERF5_OBSERVE={directory}/observe.jsonl']
        backend.launch()
        result['t0'] = backend.session.t0
        def serial_watch():
            while not stop.wait(.005):
                try:
                    content = (directory / 'serial.log').read_bytes()
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    continue
                if content and 'first_serial' not in result:
                    result['first_serial'] = backend.session.elapsed()
                if b'Linux version' in content and 'first_kernel' not in result:
                    result['first_kernel'] = backend.session.elapsed()
        watcher = threading.Thread(target=serial_watch, daemon=True)
        watcher.start()
        if profile:
            socket_path = backend.qmp_sock if label == 'qemu' else backend.control_sock
            backends._wait_socket(socket_path, backend.session, 120, 'control')
            pids = [pid for pid in lib.project_vm_pids()
                    if str(directory).encode() in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline').read_bytes()]
            if len(pids) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f'expected one VM, got {pids}')
            profile_output = (retained / 'ipsample.txt').open('w')
            profiler = subprocess.Popen([str(ROOT / '.scratch/perf5/ipsample'), str(pids[0]), '1'],
                                        stdout=profile_output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        backend.release_cpus()
        result['release'] = backend.session.elapsed()
        pids = [pid for pid in lib.project_vm_pids()
                if str(directory).encode() in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline').read_bytes()]
        if len(pids) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(f'expected one VM, got {pids}')
        pid = pids[0]
        group = Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1]
        cg = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / group.lstrip('/')
        result['cgroup'] = {name: (cg / name).read_text().strip()
                            for name in ('memory.max', 'memory.swap.max')}
        args = SimpleNamespace(backend='qemu' if label == 'qemu' else 'vmlab-hv', timeout_scale=1)
        agent, hello, seconds = run.wait_x86_ready(backend, args, guest, str(directory), backend.session.t0)
        result['boot_seconds'] = seconds
        if profiler:
            result['profiler_exit'] = profiler.wait(timeout=15)
            if result['profiler_exit'] != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f'profiler exited {result["profiler_exit"]}')
        run.log(f'{label} Linux ready in {seconds}s, first kernel {result.get("first_kernel")}')
        result['features'] = run.sh(agent,
            'for d in /sys/bus/virtio/devices/*; do '
            'kind=$(cat "$d/device"); if [ "$((kind))" -eq 1 ]; then '
            'echo "$d"; cat "$d/features"; fi; done')[1]
        result['ethtool'] = run.sh(agent, 'command -v ethtool && ethtool -k $(ls /sys/class/net | grep -v lo | head -1)')[1:]
        if workload == 'udp':
            run.sh(agent, 'timeout 90 cloud-init status --wait >/dev/null 2>&1 || true')
            nic = run.guest_nic(agent)
            run.must_sh(agent, f"ip addr replace {net['guest_ip']}/24 dev {nic} && ip link set dev {nic} mtu {net['mtu']} && ip link set {nic} up", 'NIC setup')
            run.copy_in_tools(agent, netpeer.randblke_path())
            for _ in range(3):
                peer.report()
                run.must_sh(agent, f"python3 /tmp/vmlab-nettool.py udp-blast {net['peer_ip']} {net['port']} 4096 1", 'probe')
                time.sleep(.3)
                if peer.report()['rx_bytes']:
                    break
            else:
                raise RuntimeError('UDP probe was not delivered')
            result['sends'] = []
            for index in range(3):
                peer.report()
                cpu_before = lib.process_cpu_seconds(pid)
                nice_before = os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS, pid)
                payload = run.must_sh(agent, f"python3 /tmp/vmlab-nettool.py udp-blast {net['peer_ip']} {net['port']} {net['udp_payload']} 12", 'UDP TX', timeout=90)
                sent = json.loads(payload.strip().splitlines()[-1])
                time.sleep(1)
                received = peer.report()
                sample = {'sent': sent, 'received': received, 'mbps': received['rx_bytes'] * 8 / 12 / 1e6}
                cpu_after = lib.process_cpu_seconds(pid)
                sample['cpu_seconds'] = cpu_after - cpu_before
                sample['cpu_seconds_per_gib'] = sample['cpu_seconds'] / (received['rx_bytes'] / 1024**3)
                sample['nice_before'] = nice_before
                sample['nice_after'] = os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS, pid)
                result['sends'].append(sample)
                if not sent['bytes'] or received['rx_bytes'] / sent['bytes'] < .9:
                    raise RuntimeError('UDP delivery below 90%')
                run.log(f'{label} UDP {index}: {sample["mbps"]:.2f} Mbit/s')
        result['ok'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        result['error'] = repr(error)
        raise
    finally:
        if agent:
            try:
                agent.shutdown()
            except Exception:
                pass
            agent.close()
        if backend and getattr(backend, 'session', None):
            try:
                if label != 'qemu':
                    backend.quit()
                backend.session.wait_exit(20)
            finally:
                backend.session.kill()
                result['exit'] = backend.session.exit_code()
        if peer:
            peer.kill()
        if profiler and profiler.poll() is None:
            profiler.terminate()
            profiler.wait(timeout=15)
        if profile_output:
            profile_output.close()
        stop.set()
        if watcher:
            watcher.join()
        result['load_end'] = lib.read_loadavg()
        for path in directory.iterdir():
            if path.name not in ('overlay.qcow2', 'vars.fd') and path.is_file():
                shutil.copy2(path, retained / path.name)
        (retained / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
        with (ROOT / '.scratch/perf5/linux.jsonl').open('a') as output:
            output.write(json.dumps(result) + '\n')
        shutil.rmtree(directory)
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--labels', default='qemu,current')
    parser.add_argument('--workload', default='udp')
    parser.add_argument('--rounds', type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument('--observe', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--profile', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--cpus', default='16-23')
    options = parser.parse_args()
    netpeer.compile_tools(run.log)

import argparse
import contextlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile

from boot import ROOT, slot
import lib
import netpeer
import run


def pair(label, index):
    temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='gt5-'))
    retained = ROOT / '.scratch/perf5/runs' / (temporary.name + '-' + label)
    retained.mkdir(parents=True)
    result = {'label': label, 'load_start': lib.read_loadavg(), 'retained': str(retained)}
    args = run.parse_args(['--backend', 'qemu' if label == 'qemu' else 'vmlab-hv',
                           '--keep', '--hv-bin', str(ROOT / '.scratch/perf5/binaries' / label / 'vmlab-hv')])
    original = run.g2g_direction
    previous_root = lib.RUN_DIR
    lib.RUN_DIR = str(temporary)
    def direction(*values):
        rate, sent, received = original(*values)
        result.setdefault('transfers', []).append({'mbps': rate, 'sent': sent, 'received': received})
        if sent['bytes'] != received['bytes']:
            raise RuntimeError(f'TCP byte mismatch: {sent} != {received}')
        return rate, sent, received
    run.g2g_direction = direction
    try:
        measured, _ = run.g2g_one_repeat(args, 'ubuntu-26.04', 2, '16-19', '20-23',
                                        lib.latest_template('x86_64', 'ubuntu-26.04'), index)
        result.update(measured)
        result['ok'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        result['error'] = repr(error)
        raise
    finally:
        run.g2g_direction = original
        lib.RUN_DIR = previous_root
        result['load_end'] = lib.read_loadavg()
        for path in temporary.rglob('*'):
            if path.is_file() and path.name not in ('overlay.qcow2', 'vars.fd'):
                target = retained / path.relative_to(temporary)
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy2(path, target)
        (retained / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
        with (ROOT / '.scratch/perf5/g2g.jsonl').open('a') as output:
            output.write(json.dumps(result) + '\n')
        shutil.rmtree(temporary)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--labels', default='qemu,current,wake2')
    parser.add_argument('--rounds', type=int, default=3)
    options = parser.parse_args()
    netpeer.compile_tools(run.log)
    labels = options.labels.split(',')
    for index in range(options.rounds):
        order = labels[index % len(labels):] + labels[:index % len(labels)]
        for label in order:
            with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
                stack.enter_context(slot())
                stack.enter_context(slot())
                pair(label, index + 1)
